title: Philips Neopix 444 Projector $199 (Was $699) @ Big W
body:
Deal: Philips Neopix 444 Projector $199 (Was $699) @ Big W

[nmk] I see the normal price as $242 on amazon
[Brotality] $74.29 shipping to Australia, since it's Amazon US
On this link you can use REWARDS15 to take off another $15.
I also found if you move to priority shipping and back to normal shipping, you save the shipping $8
At $184, pretty decent value
[Vash1984] Thanks for sharing, I also used with a 5% giftcard so $174.80 total
90 Days change of mind so hopefully performs a bit better than my genertic HAPPRUN 5G ($108).
Hard to compare given these chinese cheap models don't really give true specs.
Although I can't really complain about HAPPRUN 5G, dirt cheap and still get decent movie experience.
[ThemDealsThough] Reviews state this is basically a toy. Although fairly cheap…
[Jimothy Wongingtons] I kind of wonder how this will stack up to the tp350 on Ali express. I paid about $160 earlier this year for the 350
[tanksinatra] No real reviews on this product. kinda dubious
[Brotality] serious question? The c2 ultra is like 20x the price locally.. 14x off Alibaba..
[OzPeter] https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GY8934CM/ref=sspa_mw_detail_6?ie…
Better choice overall, and better reviews!
[GrumpyMe26] just ordered this Lenovo T100 850 ANSI for $149.., should i get this one instead ??
[gakko] What about the cinema inspired audio though?
[Wheresmyspaceship] Considering buying 3 to build a triple screen flight sim. I'll probably enjoy for the first 5 minutes then it'll end up in the bin.
Anyone interested in buying 3 secondhand?
[Domingo] I'm happy to fish them out of your bin once you've thrown them away
[DingoBlue] I’m yet to spot anything particularly bad but it’s worth noting that “Philips” licence their name to other manufacturers. I think they’re only interested in medical imaging and the like and as far as consumer goods go Philips doesn’t really exist anymore.
[rhino86] BigW cancelled my order for a sound card back in June 2026. Stuff them
[Duff5000] Bigw doesnt sell sound cards. Some other random resellers may sell sound cards on the "bigw marketplace" and they may have cancelled your order. Not the same thing.
[drfuzzy] I purchased a projector from Aliexpress 7 years ago for around $250 delivered. It's been fantastic. You will probably find better value there.
[archieduh] Code REWARDS15 brings it down to $184, and with gift cards its around $175 Worth the gmble even as a toy I guess. Big W has been on a roll lately.
Reviews on JB for the Model 450 (RRP $999) - 1 says all good if you keep back ventilated properly, 2 says - it keeps turning off (guess these people didn't ventilate it). All of them say the remote sucks.
So as long as the image quality holds up when ventilated. Ordered, will return if its not worth the money - I guess BigW will accept returns if its not as good.
[No Child Support] Surely pay a little more for the Magcubic HY450MAX on aliexpress for double the brightness
[scottb721] Ppl bag out these cheap projectors without offering an equally priced better alternative.
[bargainshooter] This isn't a projector review site - there are plenty for you to research.
[scottb721] Well they're comparing it against something in their review
[yummypinacolada] Bought 1. Couldn't find anything similar price with 500 ANSI lumens.
